HeroSection.title: Your digital recipe book
HeroSection.description: Store, organize, and easily find all your favorite recipes in one place.

FeaturesSection.title: What we offer
FeaturesSection.feature1_description: Works offline on your device. Sign in only to use AI or sharing.
FeaturesSection.feature3_description: Dark theme designed for cooking comfortably in low-light environments.
FeaturesSection.feature4_description: Create links to share your recipes and open them directly in the app.
FeaturesSection.feature5_description: Take a photo of any dish to generate its recipe automatically.
FeaturesSection.feature6_description: Available in multiple languages, including English, Spanish, French, and German.
